text:
ana: quick heads up 8:30 UTC deploy							

Plan: roll llm-router v5 with ff.llmroute.split_roll. Start 4% -> 20% after 10m -> 60% after 25m -> 100% after 40m. Hold at each step. pin canary to model v3.1.2. quiet window requested 08:20-09:10 UTC.

benn: deploy job db-99921 scheduled. please require manual ack for the 20% and 60% promotions; no auto advance past 20%.

riley: watching p95, 5xx, and generation-regression (eval smoke_set). Runbook thresholds: p95 > 275ms OR 5xx > 0.7% sustained 3m -> trigger softfallback to v4 pool for 60s then pause. quality_delta > 5pts -> immediate pause + page release-leads.

ana: small change: enable softfallback that reroutes 30% of affected traffic to v4-backend for 60s on first anomaly and apply a token cap 1000 tps for canary for 12m. also add a canary tag ff=rv5-canary for telemetry.

benn: put quick rollback/unpin snippets here so oncall can pin them in their notes:

```bash
# abort job
deploybot abort db-99921 --reason "rollback: guardrail"
# emergency flag off
redwoodctl flags set ff.llmroute.split_roll 0 --note "emergency revert"
# force softfallback now
redwoodctl routing set-fallback llm-route v4-backend --duration 60 --fraction 0.3
# unpin cohorts
redwoodctl runtime unpin --service llm-router --cohorts canary,staged
```

deploybot: job db-99921 started canary 4% at ts=1933333333. health gates live. manual ack required at 20% and 60%.

riley: i'll be on pager 08:20-09:20 UTC. will ack holds if smoke eval + metrics look good. if i call abort i'll paste reason and graphs here. :thumbsup:
